scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run the DFT calculations; only the results.json summary is available. Therefore we compare the submitted numeric values to the paper's reported PBE-level values with appropriate tolerances and enforce the required band-gap ordering and formation-energy positivity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for the six PBE-level properties and structural constraints.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and Section 3; confirmed against reference solve.sh which writes these exact values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper; the oracle writes them to test scoring.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the six PBE-level computed properties for the 2D/PbI and 2D/I heterostructures.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the submitted numeric values to the paper's reported PBE-level values with appropriate tolerances, and verifies the relative ordering (band_gap_I > band_gap_PbI) and positivity of both formation energies.
